title: Camera reframe with glass panel over footage
what_it_does: HyperFrames scene template: crop and reframe a talking-head clip to one side while an animated glass card pops out on the other; supply source.mp4 and edit copy and timing.
when_to_use: A talking-head intro or key point with one card.
why: MIT; real hyperframes.json project at 1920x1080/60fps; loads GSAP from a CDN, so localise it when copying.
